description: This PHP source file defines a final class 'DeprecatedCallableInfo' within the Twig namespace. The class contains private properties, a constructor, setter methods, and a method to trigger deprecation notices related to deprecated callables in Twig. It is part of Twig's internal deprecation handling mechanism.

classes.name: DeprecatedCallableInfo
classes.description: Final class to manage deprecated callable information and issue deprecation notices within Twig.
